title: About viggo.games
intro: is a collection of browser games made by Viggo, built for fun, learning, and a bit of arcade nostalgia.
story: All games on this site are designed and developed by Viggo with a little help from his dad and Codex. Every mission is free to play in a modern browser, with no download required.
